**Site & Staff**
62 vehicles; 140 drivers.
Ops lead: Halvard Onstad.
Night supervisor: Teodora Blaskovic.
Night shift not fully staffed.

**Certification & Compliance**
Certified June 2023; renewal due June 2028.
Incident reports: within 24 hours.
Route changes: 7 days' notice.

**Operations**
410 average daily departures; 530 winter peak.
Cancellations: 1.8%.
Winter peak capacity next year: not modelled.

**Maintenance**
8 lifts; 1100 parts line items.
Brake check every 6000 km.
Feb 2025: 9 vehicles grounded 4 days; cause unestablished.
Parts contract renegotiated Nov 2025; supplier contact Ingrid Solheim.
Parts over €500: two quotations.

**Finance & Systems**
Sept 2024 fuel card cloning: €4200 lost.
Fuel cards over €200: second approval.
Electrification study approved, unfunded; second charging bay Q3.
Old ticketing terminal on 3 routes.

**Training & Rostering**
Training: 11 days; curriculum revised April 2026.
May 2026: roster published twice, 2 shifts uncovered.
Roster requires single named publisher.
